title: GenerationBrief
description: Typed planner-to-drafter contract. Emitted by Plot Architect, consumed by Prose Stylist. Replaces the 8-section free-text brief with structured fields. Free text lives at the leaves; orchestration shape is typed at the top.

scene_objective.description: What this scene must accomplish structurally. One or two sentences. Derived from scene_card.mission plus context.

opening_mode.description: How the scene should open. Drives Prose Stylist's first-paragraph choices.

key_beats.description: 3-5 specific story beats the scene must execute, in order.

state_change.description: What changes as a result of this beat.

pov_reaction.description: POV character's internal response (thought, sensation, or impulse — not narrated emotion).

turning_point.description: How the scene's turning point lands. Every required field surfaces as a separate prompt section for Prose Stylist.

shift.description: How scene dynamics change after the trigger.

cost.description: What the turn costs the POV character — emotional, relational, or strategic.

closing_beat.description: The scene's final beat. Must land on or near scene_card.closing_hook — Prose Stylist treats this as a hard boundary.

emotional_arc.description: POV character's emotional trajectory across the scene. Start and end are named states; shift is the transition.

shift.description: The pivot — what changes and why.

voice_guidance.description: Sentence rhythm, vocabulary choices, tonal palette. Reference register (e.g., Zahn/Allston/Golden) lives here if applicable.

forbidden_moves.description: Things that MUST NOT happen in this scene. Typically structural phase violations or canon limits.

delivery_preferences.description: How the scene's information should reach the reader. Controls reveal pacing and exposition density.

reveal_mode.description: How revelations land. `direct` = stated on the page; `gradual` = layered across beats; `subtext` = implied, reader reconstructs.

exposition_budget.description: How much worldbuilding/backstory prose is allowed. `none` = scene must carry zero exposition.

register_override.description: If this scene departs from the concept seed's default voice register, name the override (e.g., 'clinical' for an autopsy scene). Null otherwise.

required_hooks.description: Hook IDs (from concept_seed.hooks) to plant, advance, or resolve. Must match scene_card.hook_actions.

required_subplots.description: Subplot IDs (from concept_seed.subplots) to touch in this scene.

required_revelations.description: Revelation IDs (from concept_seed.revelations) to deliver in this scene.

anti_patterns.description: Moves the drafter must avoid. Extracted from scene_card.notes by the Plot Architect — surfacing them explicitly raises their salience in the Prose Stylist's prompt.

target_word_count.description: Target word count for the scene. Must match scene_card.target_word_count — the brief echoes it so Prose Stylist does not have to cross-reference.
